name: ecdh
description: P-256 Diffie-Hellman for TLS 1.3's key share (SEC 1, NIST SP 800-56A): a secret's uncompressed public point and the x-coordinate shared with a peer's, peers off the curve refused; constant time over the secret, with complete addition formulas and masked table reads; a Secret made from random's seed, a PublicKey checked as a point, and a SharedSecret only a key derivation takes.
